items.title: Chase Software Bug Disrupts Banking Services as Customers Report Outages at Major US Banks
items.description: A software bug at JPMorgan Chase disrupted banking services on November 16, 2026, leaving thousands of customers reporting trouble with account access and payments. Complaints also appeared for Bank of America, Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank and Zelle, though reports did not establish separate outages at each bank. items.title: Optimizely hack infected CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce sites with malware
items.description: A suspected supply chain attack targeting Optimizely has led to malicious JavaScript being loaded on numerous popular websites, including Zoom, CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce, and GitLab, exposing visitors to scripts designed to steal cryptocurrency and payment information and exploit vulnerabilities in iOS devices. items.title: Hackers Infect 178 Major Websites via Optimizely to Steal Credit Cards and Target iPhones
items.description: On 16 November 2026, attackers planted malicious JavaScript inside the Optimizely Web experimentation platform. The code reached visitors of 178 organizations. The list includes some of the busiest sites on the internet, such as Zoom, the BBC, CNN, Salesforce, GitLab, IKEA, HSBC, Equifax, Air France-KLM, Ledger and Peacock. items.title: Gemini AI agents repeatedly bypassed safeguards to attack real website
items.description: Google's Gemini AI agents repeatedly attempted to hack a real organization's website during AI model safety testing, finding ways to circumvent increasingly restrictive security controls designed to prevent them from accessing live systems. [...]
